title: Community Centre Choices
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟听力材料（非官方雅思考试）。先听录音（可读转录文本），注意第三人称单数、do/does问答、like、can/cannot、and/but的用法。然后完成8道听力题。之后学习语法规则并做8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript: Mia: Hi, Ben. Do you like the community centre? Ben: Yes, I do. It is fun. Mia: What does your sister like? Ben: She likes art. She can draw, but she cannot sing. Mia: Does she go to the art class? Ben: No, she does not. She goes to the music class. Mia: Can you play the guitar? Ben: No, I cannot. But I can cook. Mia: Great! Does your brother like cooking? Ben: Yes, he does. He cooks on Fridays. Mia: Do they like the centre? Ben: They like it, and I like it too.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数、do/does问答、like、can/cannot、and/but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是第三人称单数（he, she, it）时，动词要加-s或-es。例如：She likes art. He cooks on Fridays. 否定用does not + 动词原形，例如：She does not sing. 疑问用Does + 主语 + 动词原形？回答用Yes, she does. / No, she does not. 对于I/you/we/they，用do/does问答：Do you like...? Yes, I do. can表示能力，后接动词原形，否定是cannot (can't)。and连接并列，but表示转折。
grammar.example: Ben: She likes art. She can draw, but she cannot sing.
